# Pricing & Packaging

`pricing-and-packaging` · v1.1.1 · Design · Strategy & Positioning
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/pricing-and-packaging/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Do our tiers and price points hold together: is the top tier a real anchor, and where does revenue actually come from?

**Inputs:** The ICP/segments and what each values, the differentiator, proof, rough willingness to pay, and competitor pricing.

**Output:** A value metric, good-better-best tiers with prices, a modeled blended ARPU, revenue mix, price ladder and anchor check, and the upgrade logic.

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill pricing-and-packaging`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/pricing-and-packaging/resources/price-packaging.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/pricing-and-packaging/resources/price-packaging.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON. It can read an input file you name on the command line; it reads nothing else.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It does the arithmetic on the tiers you enter: ARPU, revenue mix, price steps and the anchor. It can't tell you what buyers will pay or which value metric fits.
- For a product with no customers, the mix is your estimate, so the ARPU and revenue mix are assumptions, not a forecast.
- The 1.5x weak-anchor line is this engine's rule of thumb, not a published benchmark.
- An unrecognised tier field, or a price or customer count that isn't a number, stops the run with an error naming the tier. It can't tell whether the numbers themselves are right.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns pricing checks the tier prices and the customer mix, marked as an estimate if projected. The finance lead cross-checks the blended ARPU against CAC and payback in unit-economics before any price goes live.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/pricing-and-packaging](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/pricing-and-packaging)
